EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S1.title: Define Specialty Match Transparency Schema and Contract
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S1.description: Define response schema exposing matched_classifications, including classification labels, confidence (if available), and pipeline origin flags (regex, vector, or both). Ensure compatibility with existing specialty_service outputs.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S2.description: Extend specialty_service to explicitly tag each matched classification with its originating pipeline (regex, vector, or both), preserving existing deduplication and aggregation behavior.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Transparency
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S4.description: Create unit and integration tests validating pipeline attribution (regex/vector/both), dual matches, and stability with query expansion and deduplication logic.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S5.title: Render Specialty Match Transparency in Chat UI
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S5.description: Update frontend message rendering to display matched specialties along with pipeline attribution (e.g., regex, vector, both) in a user-understandable format, ensuring no disruption to existing chat UX.
